ls -la data/ && echo "---raw_a---" && head data/raw_a.csv && echo "---raw_b---" && head data/raw_b.csv && echo "---counts---" && wc -l data/raw_a.csv data/raw_b.csv
cat data/schema.md
gcloud config list 2>&1; echo "---"; which bq gcloud

for grp in feature-groups feature-online-stores; do echo "=== gcloud beta ai $grp ==="; gcloud beta ai $grp --help 2>&1 | head -8; done
tool_input.description: Probe beta feature store command groups

tool_input.command:
DS="$GCP_PROJECT:$GCP_BQ_DATASET"
echo "Loading rawa55c41b..."
bq load --replace --source_format=CSV --skip_leading_rows=1 \
  --schema='row_id:STRING,a_val:FLOAT' \
  "$DS.rawa55c41b" data/raw_a.csv 2>&1
echo "Loading rawb55c41b..."
bq load --replace --source_format=CSV --skip_leading_rows=1 \
  --schema='row_id:STRING,b_val:FLOAT' \
  "$DS.rawb55c41b" data/raw_b.csv 2>&1
tool_input.description: Load raw CSVs into BigQuery feature tables

tool_input.command:
DS="$GCP_PROJECT:$GCP_BQ_DATASET"
echo "rawa count:"; bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv "SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM \`$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET.rawa55c41b\`" 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "rawb count:"; bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv "SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM \`$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET.rawb55c41b\`" 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "inner-join count:"; bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv "SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM \`$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET.rawa55c41b\` a JOIN \`$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET.rawb55c41b\` b USING(row_id)" 2>&1 | tail -1
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv 'SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM `***REDACTED***.mlpab_mlpab9d59bc.rawa55c41b`' 2>&1 | tail -2

bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv 'SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `***REDACTED***.mlpab_mlpab9d59bc.rawb55c41b`) AS rawb, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `***REDACTED***.mlpab_mlpab9d59bc.rawa55c41b` a JOIN `***REDACTED***.mlpab_mlpab9d59bc.rawb55c41b` b USING(row_id)) AS overlap' 2>&1 | tail -2

bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --replace \
  --destination_table="$GCP_PROJECT:$GCP_BQ_DATASET.derived55c41b" \
  'SELECT a.row_id AS row_id, ROUND(a.a_val + b.b_val, 6) AS col_sum FROM `***REDACTED***.mlpab_mlpab9d59bc.rawa55c41b` a JOIN `***REDACTED***.mlpab_mlpab9d59bc.rawb55c41b` b USING(row_id)' 2>&1 | tail -3
tool_input.description: Create derived table via join, auto-registering lineage

tool_input.command:
echo "schema:"; bq show --format=prettyjson "$GCP_PROJECT:$GCP_BQ_DATASET.derived55c41b" 2>&1 | grep -A20 '"schema"' | head -25
echo "---count & sample---"
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv 'SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(SUM(col_sum),6) AS total FROM `***REDACTED***.mlpab_mlpab9d59bc.derived55c41b`' 2>&1 | tail -2
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv 'SELECT * FROM `***REDACTED***.mlpab_mlpab9d59bc.derived55c41b` ORDER BY row_id LIMIT 5' 2>&1 | tail -6
tool_input.description: Verify derived table schema and content

tool_input.command:
mkdir -p submission
printf '{"derived_from": ["rawa55c41b", "rawb55c41b"]}\n' > submission/answers.json
cat submission/answers.json
echo "--- exporting derived CSV fallback ---"
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv 'SELECT row_id, col_sum FROM `***REDACTED***.mlpab_mlpab9d59bc.derived55c41b` ORDER BY row_id' > submission/derived55c41b.csv 2>/dev/null
head -3 submission/derived55c41b.csv; echo "..."; wc -l submission/derived55c41b.csv
tool_input.description: Write answers.json and export derived CSV

tool_input.command:
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv --max_rows=100000 'SELECT row_id, col_sum FROM `***REDACTED***.mlpab_mlpab9d59bc.derived55c41b` ORDER BY row_id' > submission/derived55c41b.csv 2>/dev/null
wc -l submission/derived55c41b.csv; head -2 submission/derived55c41b.csv; tail -1 submission/derived55c41b.csv
bq ls --format=pretty "$GCP_PROJECT:$GCP_BQ_DATASET" 2>&1
tool_input.description: List all tables in the dataset
